attribution: Actual execution used this committed clean source unchanged throughout. Later receipt-only commits are not relabeled as the tested source. Historical scalar/managed receipts retain their original source and policy identities.

source.scope: Complete ordinary source, including original resource requirements, read, algorithm and send; ordinary compilation to original and bytecode-decoded ProgramArtifact variants. No source/resource stripping, fake output or workload-sized Rust helper.

qualification.profile: Locked/offline serial correctness builds; debug/test opt0, debug0, assertions and overflow checks enabled, incremental disabled. Not release performance builds.
qualification.selection: Fresh Cargo compiler-artifact executable record, then exact ignored method execution: 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored, 0 measured, 14 filtered out. This run does not add execution credit for the 14 normal methods.
qualification.supervision: Serial owned-process-group supervision; outer qualification deadline6000s, inner initial builds900s and launches/pin cases120s, bounded cleanup. Stage elapsed durations are supervision evidence, not benchmark samples.

fixture_policy.scope: Explicit finite fixture policy, unchanged by this qualification; not a claim that these are product defaults or a full-input policy. Input acquisition has its own cap; native memory accounting does not claim provider-cache bytes.

coverage: Each artifact variant runs the same 33-byte FASTA fixture with a four-base THREE record GGTA, exact-input acquisition cap, and a 15-byte fixture with an empty THREE record. Complete literal independent output oracles match; source completeness is not standard-input coverage.
Missing read/write grants reject even with MECH_NATIVE_SECURITY=trusted. Work=1, input-cap3, overflowing input cap and invalid UTF-8 reject with empty stdout and no requested success report.
A closed real stdout pipe reports CommittedWithFailures, preserving post-commit delivery-failure classification rather than claiming rollback.

Each accepted report records admit-activate-capture-resume, native_aot=true, secured policy, no source parser/JIT/resident body, original revision and completed shutdown. Observations/effects use the shared CLI capability/provider/transaction services.

Nine generated-input mutations reject: identity stack claim, Object, bytecode, source provenance, manifest pins, main, build script, toolchain and Cargo manifest. All inputs restore and the restored build preserves the binary.

artifacts.emission_metadata: Generated manifests remain linked=false/executed=false/timing_samples=0; this separate actual-process receipt establishes linking and execution.

runtime_closure.deduplication: Shared closure helper retains the first package/full-target/feature record; one serde_json host/target occurrence differs only in output filenames. Complete raw compiler messages are retained and every message is checked.
runtime_closure.authority: Runtime-only installation of the same maintained native-plan/resident contract witnesses and shared capability services; no resident body evaluation or second source compiler. Actual compiled units, not just the manifest dependency list, establish the closure.
runtime_closure.warnings: Existing selected-machine unused-code warnings remain; warning-free standalone compilation is not claimed.

accounted_work_not_timings.scope: Cumulative native work units under the unchanged1e9 fixture cap; these are not nanoseconds, elapsed durations, speedups or language rankings.

local_evidence.availability: Full projects, raw compiler units, process streams, mutations and binaries remain local evidence, not committed products. Reproduce using the maintained qualifier and README instructions from source_commit; required canonical-hosted CI generates and uploads its own fresh evidence.

not_established: Standard FASTA N=25000000 / THREE125000000 bases, all seven nontrivial full-size histograms, other nine programs or whole-program optimization.
Production native-build CLI migration, persistent resource/state lifecycle, non-tail recursion or element-wise counts beyond currently selected support.

Trusted/secured same-binary performance comparison: this generated application is secured-only and ignores the legacy trusted environment for authority. No release timings or new performance/ranking claim.
Fresh exact-head clean review or complete green GitHub CI; local qualification does not authorize readiness or merge.
